product.name: Aurelio MultiComp Desk Organizer
product.description: The Aurelio MultiComp Desk Organizer is a compact, modular solution for keeping office supplies tidy. Its layered design features three adjustable trays, a dedicated slot for pens and a pull‑out drawer for business cards. Constructed from sustainably sourced wood veneer bonded to reinforced cardboard, the unit offers a sturdy yet lightweight frame. Silicone feet provide stability and protect desk surfaces. The deep mahogany finish gives a professional look that blends with contemporary office décor. Users can customize the internal layout by adding or removing trays, making it suitable for both home offices and corporate settings.
